changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Derive the portfolio and delinquency report from dated native loan transactions and repayment schedules instead of the empty cutoff table.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE credesal_report_office_is_root( selected_office.id, '${officeId}', '${currentUserHierarchy}' ) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), resolved_cutoff AS ( SELECT LEAST( CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(last_closed_business_date) FROM m_loan), CURRENT_DATE) ) AS snapshot_date WHERE CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) <= LEAST( CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(last_closed_business_date) FROM m_loan), CURRENT_DATE) ) ), eligible_loans AS ( SELECT loan.id, loan.product_id, loan.disbursedon_date, loan.expected_maturedon_date, loan.currency_code, client.office_id FROM m_loan loan JOIN m_client client ON client.id = loan.client_id JOIN selected_offices selected ON selected.id = client.office_id CROSS JOIN resolved_cutoff cutoff WHERE loan.disbursedon_date <= cutoff.snapshot_date AND (loan.closedon_date IS NULL OR loan.closedon_date > cutoff.snapshot_date) AND (loan.writtenoffon_date IS NULL OR loan.writtenoffon_date > cutoff.snapshot_date) AND loan.currency_code = 'USD' ), loan_cash_flows AS ( SELECT loan.id AS loan_id, COALESCE(SUM(transaction.amount) FILTER ( WHERE transaction.transaction_type_enum = 1 ), 0.00) AS disbursed_amount, COALESCE(SUM(transaction.principal_portion_derived) FILTER ( WHERE transaction.transaction_type_enum = 2 ), 0.00) AS principal_repaid FROM eligible_loans loan CROSS JOIN resolved_cutoff cutoff LEFT JOIN m_loan_transaction transaction ON transaction.loan_id = loan.id AND transaction.transaction_date <= cutoff.snapshot_date AND NOT transaction.is_reversed AND transaction.transaction_type_enum IN (1, 2) GROUP BY loan.id ), installment_paid AS ( SELECT mapping.loan_repayment_schedule_id, SUM(mapping.principal_portion_derived) AS principal_paid, SUM(mapping.interest_portion_derived) AS interest_paid FROM m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping mapping JOIN m_loan_transaction transaction ON transaction.id = mapping.loan_transaction_id JOIN eligible_loans loan ON loan.id = transaction.loan_id CROSS JOIN resolved_cutoff cutoff WHERE transaction.transaction_date <= cutoff.snapshot_date AND transaction.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND NOT transaction.is_reversed GROUP BY mapping.loan_repayment_schedule_id ), loan_arrears AS ( SELECT schedule.loan_id, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST( schedule.principal_amount - COALESCE(paid.principal_paid, 0.00), 0.00 )), 0.00) AS overdue_principal, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST( schedule.interest_amount - COALESCE(paid.interest_paid, 0.00), 0.00 )), 0.00) AS overdue_interest, MIN(schedule.duedate) FILTER ( WHERE schedule.principal_amount - COALESCE(paid.principal_paid, 0.00) > 0.01 OR schedule.interest_amount - COALESCE(paid.interest_paid, 0.00) > 0.01 ) AS first_overdue_date FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule schedule JOIN eligible_loans loan ON loan.id = schedule.loan_id CROSS JOIN resolved_cutoff cutoff LEFT JOIN installment_paid paid ON paid.loan_repayment_schedule_id = schedule.id WHERE schedule.duedate < cutoff.snapshot_date GROUP BY schedule.loan_id ), portfolio AS ( SELECT cutoff.snapshot_date, CASE WHEN loan.expected_maturedon_date - loan.disbursedon_date <= 366 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS term_order, CASE WHEN loan.expected_maturedon_date - loan.disbursedon_date <= 366 THEN 'CORTO PLAZO' ELSE 'LARGO PLAZO' END AS term_type, office.hierarchy AS office_hierarchy, office.id AS office_id, office.name AS office_name, product.id AS product_id, product.name AS credit_line, CASE WHEN arrears.first_overdue_date IS NULL OR cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 7 THEN '1' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 30 THEN '2' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 60 THEN '3' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 90 THEN '4' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 120 THEN '5' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 150 THEN '6' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 180 THEN '7' ELSE '8' END AS risk_classification_id, CASE WHEN arrears.first_overdue_date IS NULL OR cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 7 THEN 'A1' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 30 THEN 'A2' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 60 THEN 'B' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 90 THEN 'C1' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 120 THEN 'C2' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 150 THEN 'D1' WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 180 THEN 'D2' ELSE 'E' END AS risk_classification, CASE WHEN arrears.first_overdue_date IS NULL OR cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 7 THEN 1 WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 30 THEN 2 WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 60 THEN 3 WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 90 THEN 4 WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 120 THEN 5 WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 150 THEN 6 WHEN cutoff.snapshot_date - arrears.first_overdue_date <= 180 THEN 7 ELSE 8 END AS risk_order, cash.disbursed_amount, GREATEST(cash.disbursed_amount - cash.principal_repaid, 0.00) AS principal_balance, LEAST(COALESCE(arrears.overdue_principal, 0.00), GREATEST(cash.disbursed_amount - cash.principal_repaid, 0.00)) AS overdue_principal, COALESCE(arrears.overdue_interest, 0.00) AS overdue_interest, CASE WHEN COALESCE(arrears.overdue_principal, 0.00) > 0.01 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS portfolio_status FROM eligible_loans loan CROSS JOIN resolved_cutoff cutoff JOIN loan_cash_flows cash ON cash.loan_id = loan.id LEFT JOIN loan_arrears arrears ON arrears.loan_id = loan.id JOIN m_office office ON office.id = loan.office_id JOIN m_product_loan product ON product.id = loan.product_id WHERE cash.disbursed_amount - cash.principal_repaid > 0.01 ), classification_rows AS ( SELECT term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, product_id, credit_line, risk_order, risk_classification, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_classification_id <> '1') AS loans_in_arrears_count, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS disbursed_amount, SUM(principal_balance) AS principal_balance, SUM(principal_balance) FILTER (WHERE risk_classification_id <> '1') AS affected_portfolio, SUM(overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal, SUM(overdue_interest) AS overdue_interest, SUM(principal_balance) FILTER (WHERE portfolio_status = '1') AS current_portfolio, SUM(principal_balance) FILTER (WHERE portfolio_status = '2') AS overdue_portfolio FROM portfolio GROUP BY term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, product_id, credit_line, risk_order, risk_classification ), display_rows AS ( SELECT term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, product_id, credit_line, 1 AS row_order, risk_order, 'CLASIFICACION'::VARCHAR AS row_type, risk_classification AS classification, loan_count, loans_in_arrears_count, disbursed_amount, principal_balance, COALESCE(affected_portfolio, 0.00) AS affected_portfolio, overdue_principal, overdue_interest, COALESCE(current_portfolio, 0.00) AS current_portfolio, COALESCE(overdue_portfolio, 0.00) AS overdue_portfolio FROM classification_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, product_id, credit_line, 2, 999, 'TOTAL_LINEA', NULL, SUM(loan_count), SUM(loans_in_arrears_count), SUM(disbursed_amount), SUM(principal_balance), SUM(affected_portfolio), SUM(overdue_principal), SUM(overdue_interest), SUM(current_portfolio), SUM(overdue_portfolio) FROM classification_rows GROUP BY term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, product_id, credit_line
UNION ALL
SELECT term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, NULL, NULL, 3, 999, 'TOTAL_SUCURSAL', NULL, SUM(loan_count), SUM(loans_in_arrears_count), SUM(disbursed_amount), SUM(principal_balance), SUM(affected_portfolio), SUM(overdue_principal), SUM(overdue_interest), SUM(current_portfolio), SUM(overdue_portfolio) FROM classification_rows GROUP BY term_order, term_type, office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name
UNION ALL
SELECT term_order, term_type, '~~~~', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 4, 999, 'TOTAL_PLAZO', NULL, SUM(loan_count), SUM(loans_in_arrears_count), SUM(disbursed_amount), SUM(principal_balance), SUM(affected_portfolio), SUM(overdue_principal), SUM(overdue_interest), SUM(current_portfolio), SUM(overdue_portfolio) FROM classification_rows GROUP BY term_order, term_type
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, NULL, '~~~~', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 5, 999, 'TOTAL_GENERAL', NULL, SUM(loan_count), SUM(loans_in_arrears_count), SUM(disbursed_amount), SUM(principal_balance), SUM(affected_portfolio), SUM(overdue_principal), SUM(overdue_interest), SUM(current_portfolio), SUM(overdue_portfolio) FROM classification_rows HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), grand_total AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(principal_balance), 0.00) AS principal_balance FROM classification_rows ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY row.term_order, row.office_hierarchy COLLATE "C", row.product_id NULLS LAST, row.row_order, row.risk_order ) AS "Orden", row.row_type AS "Tipo Fila", row.term_type AS "Tipo Plazo", row.office_id AS "Id Oficina", row.office_name AS "Sucursal", row.product_id AS "Id Línea Crédito", row.credit_line AS "Línea Crédito", row.classification AS "CLSF", row.loan_count AS "Cantidad Préstamos", row.loans_in_arrears_count AS "Cantidad Préstamos en Mora", ROUND(row.disbursed_amount, 2) AS "Monto Desembolsado", ROUND(row.principal_balance, 2) AS "Saldo Capital", ROUND(row.affected_portfolio, 2) AS "Cartera Afectada", ROUND(row.overdue_principal, 2) AS "Capital Vencido", ROUND(row.overdue_interest, 2) AS "Interés Vencido", ROUND(row.current_portfolio, 2) AS "Cartera Vigente", ROUND(row.overdue_portfolio, 2) AS "Cartera Vencida", CASE WHEN total.principal_balance = 0.00 THEN 0.0000 ELSE ROUND(row.principal_balance * 100.0 / total.principal_balance, 4) END AS "Porcentaje Cartera %", CASE WHEN total.principal_balance = 0.00 THEN 0.0000 ELSE ROUND(row.overdue_principal * 100.0 / total.principal_balance, 4) END AS "Porcentaje Vencido %", cutoff.snapshot_date AS "Fecha Corte", TO_CHAR(CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Período" FROM display_rows row CROSS JOIN grand_total total CROSS JOIN resolved_cutoff cutoff ORDER BY row.term_order, row.office_hierarchy COLLATE "C", row.product_id NULLS LAST, row.row_order, row.risk_order $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Detalle de Saldos de Préstamos y Morosidad';
